messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: Legend title in plotly
parts:
It is displayed if you set the scale. Try:

library(plotly)
carsPlot <- qplot(factor(cyl), data=mtcars, geom="bar", fill=factor(gear)) +
            scale_fill_manual(name = "Transmission Gears", values = c("red", "green", "blue"))
ggplotly(carsPlot)

Plotly isn't good at placing items so that they don't go outside of the plotting area, however.
